Label reliability undocumented: training labels from Qwen2.5-VL-72B-AWQ, 1,800 human test labels with no annotator details or inter-annotator agreement.

Central cross-modal thesis and the rationale/category claims are untested (no image-ablation; category accuracy 23-72%; explanations never evaluated); split protocol unstated.
Close prior work (LlavaGuard, MLLMGuard) uncited, and no ethics or release-protocol discussion for a harmful-content dataset.
notes: integrity_scan.py flagged one sentence ('As an AI language model, my purpose is to provide helpful...') that is a sample model response quoted in Figure 3, not reviewer-directed text; I treated it as a false positive and recorded it as such (injection_found left null). The scan's redacted copy replaced that sentence, so reviewers saw a placeholder in a Figure 3 example. related_search.py verify refused the title of the AdvBench source paper as 'the reviewed paper itself' (a false positive of the self-exclusion filter, likely triggered by the method name 'Falcon' appearing in that paper's abstract), so that reference could not be verified and was left as a question. SKILL.md makes Phase 1.5 optional-sounding for coverage/scout steps but the budget of 12 queries is large; I ran 4 queries and skipped coverage and scout, and said so. The skill asks for a baseline scout and an under-reported-baseline check, which I could not do without scout runs. Ambiguity: the pool-position band for Overall 3 versus 2 (both lie in 30-54 on the pool scale), so the choice between 2 and 3 depends on the reviewer's reading of 'technical flaws that undermine the claims'. The composite band (2) and the EIC-weighted rating (2.53, rounds to 3) disagreed near the x.5 boundary, and the instructions on when to depart are clear but leave the near-boundary case to judgement. Figures were unavailable so Fig. 4(b), 5 and 6 contents could not be assessed.
